honor: Order of the White Lion, civil division, first class (Řád Bílého lva)
awarded_by: President of the Czech Republic, Miloš Zeman
detail: Listed first among the recipients of the Order of the White Lion, civil division, first class, 'for particularly outstanding merit for the Czech Republic', on the official list of Czech state decorations for the national holiday of 28 October 2014. ČT24 had reported beforehand, citing Mladá fronta Dnes, that the award was meant to recognise good Czech-Slovak neighbourly relations.
